class.name: FellowMotionModel
class.brief_description: FellowEngine: a neural motion model (MotionBricks SOMA) run on the GPU.
class.description: Loads a [code].fmb[/code] file — NVIDIA's MotionBricks SOMA checkpoints converted by [code]modules/fellow_motion/tools/fmb_convert.py[/code] (the weights are NVIDIA's, under the NVIDIA Open Model Agreement, and are not part of the engine) — and runs it on a local [RenderingDevice] of its own: a GPU queue beside the renderer's. One [method run] generates a batch of independent requests, each from four context poses and up to four target poses, of 24 to 64 frames of motion at 30 Hz, with the ONNX model's inputs and outputs (MotionBricks' [code]docs/onnx_inference.md[/code]): [code]global_root_values[/code] [N, 8, 5], [code]has_global_root_values[/code] [N, 8], [code]local_root_values[/code] [N, 8, 4], [code]has_local_root_values[/code] [N, 8], [code]local_poses[/code] [N, 8, 267], [code]has_local_poses[/code] [N, 8], [code]allowed_pred_num_tokens[/code] [N, 11] in; [code]pred_global_motions[/code] [N, 64, 366] and [code]pred_num_tokens[/code] [N] out (row-major packed arrays). The weights are fp16 or fp32 as converted; the arithmetic is fp32. [FellowMotionCharacter3D] drives characters with it. See [code]docs/decisions/0143-neural-motion.md[/code].

method.name: get_activation
method.description: Reads one of the plan's activation tensors back after a run (the first [param count] requests; all [method get_max_batch] if negative). For tests.

method.name: get_info
method.description: The file, its weight precision, the number of ops, the largest batch, the activation and scratch memory, the device and the model's license notice.

method.name: get_last_timings
method.description: The last run's CPU times (recording, submit and wait, read-back and decoding); with [member profile], the GPU time of the whole plan and of each op.

method.name: get_max_batch
method.description: The largest batch a run takes (set by [method load]).

method.name: load
method.description: Loads an [code].fmb[/code] file, creates the model's device, compiles its shaders and uploads the weights (about 380 MB in fp16). [param max_batch] sizes the activations.

method.name: run
method.description: Runs one batch (the size taken from [code]global_root_values[/code]) and waits for it. Returns [code]pred_global_motions[/code] and [code]pred_num_tokens[/code], or an empty dictionary on an error.

members.member: Run the matrix products on tensor cores (VK_KHR_cooperative_matrix: 16x16x16 blocks, fp16 inputs, fp32 accumulation) when the device has them, the weights are fp16 and its subgroup size is fixed. Set before [method load]. The activations are rounded to fp16 for the products (as NVIDIA's mixed-FP16 model does); off, the products are fp32. With a subgroup of 32 or less the tensor-core kernel reads the activations four at a time (the environment variable [code]FELLOW_MOTION_GEMM=scalar[/code], a diagnostic, turns that off). [method get_info] tells which runs.
GPU timestamps around every op (needs [code]debug/settings/profiler/max_timestamp_query_elements[/code] above the op count).
Small matrix products are split along K until they have at least this many workgroups (split-K, then a reduction).
